title: 第16章 省赛名额
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
下午一点四十。

    锦城大学武道学院，三号训练室。

    下节课是标准练气导论课，这是周二下午的固定课程。

    此时，训练室里已经来了大半个班的人。

    几十号学生三三两两地散坐在训练室边沿的长椅上，有的在压腿热身，有的在低头刷手机。

    闲聊声在空旷的室内来回碰撞。

    训练室的门被推开。

    陈峰走了进来。

    下一刻。

    整个训练室的声音安静了一下，几十道目光投了过来。

    “我操，太阳打西边出来了？”

    “陈峰？他怎么来了？”

    “多少天没见了这是？好几天了吧？”

    “不止，上次见他还是那回测体质，之后就再没出现过，有半个月了。”

    “这时候过来……该不会是来参加省赛名额选拔的吧？”

    “怎么可能，上次测体质他才十二点，距离淬体中期还差一大截呢。”

    ……

    窃窃私语从四面八方冒出来。

    陈峰扫了一圈，没理会这些目光，径直走到训练室靠后的位置站定。

    而此时，冯曦正在站在前排看手机。

    听到动静，她侧过头，扫了陈峰一眼，又一脸平淡的收了回去。

    无所谓了。

    虽然上次她花钱让陈峰回来上课，陈峰没有同意。

    但冯曦也并没有就此放弃。

    陈峰旷课的这半个月里，她先后找了梁越三次，以班级出勤率和教学秩序为由，请求梁越勒令陈峰回来上课。

    老梁嘴上没松口，但态度已经明显动摇了。

    上周五下午，老梁甚至主动跟她说，“陈峰那边，我找个时间跟他谈谈。”

    这话一出，冯曦就知道，这事稳了。

    只要老梁发话，收回之前的承诺，陈峰就得老老实实回来上课。

    出勤率恢复正常，她的优秀班干部评选不会再有任何问题。

    至于陈峰今天是来干什么，是不是想参加省赛选拔……

    冯曦滑动了一下手机屏幕，没当回事。

    这是不可能的事情。

    她收回心思，继续看手机。

    另一边。

    吴志超和林远凑了过来。

    “峰哥？”

    吴志超一脸稀奇，“你今天怎么舍得来了？我还以为你准备旷到期末呢。”

    陈峰微微挑眉：“来上课不行？”

    “行，当然行。”吴志超嘿嘿笑了两声，“那啥，今天是省赛名额选拔，你该不会是来参加省赛的吧？”

    林远看了吴志超一眼，接了一句：“省赛选拔体质要13点，陈峰才12点多，可别瞎说。”

    然而陈峰却没解释，只是平静的点了点头。

    “我就是来参加选拔的。”

    “啊？”

    吴志超和林远微微愣住，随后有些错愕的对视一眼，险些怀疑自己是不是听错了。

    两人还想再问。

    这时，上课铃声响起。

    “叮——”

    训练室的门从外面被推开，梁越夹着文件夹走了进来。

    他穿着一身灰色运动服，头发剃得很短，精神头不错。

    进门之后先扫了一圈人头，目光掠过陈峰的位置时，脚步微微慢了半拍。
content_en:
One forty in the afternoon.

Jincheng University Martial Arts Academy, Training Room No. 3.

The next class is an introduction to standard Qi training, which is a regular class on Tuesday afternoons.

At this time, most of the class was already in the training room.

Dozens of students were sitting in twos and threes on the benches at the edge of the training room. Some were pressing their legs to warm up, and some were browsing their mobile phones with their heads down.

The sound of chatter bounced back and forth in the empty room.

The training room door was pushed open.

Chen Feng walked in.

The next moment.

The entire training room fell silent, and dozens of eyes came over.

"Holy shit, the sun is coming out in the west?"

"Chen Feng? Why is he here?"

"How many days have we not seen this? How many days has it been?"

"Not only that, the last time I saw him was when he was taking a physical fitness test, and he hasn't been seen since then. It's been half a month."

"Come here now...could it be that you are here to participate in the provincial competition quota selection?"

"How is it possible? The last time his physique was measured, he was only at 12 o'clock. He is still far away from the middle stage of body tempering."

…

Whispers came from all directions.

Chen Feng glanced around, ignored the glances, and walked straight to the back of the training room to stand.

At this time, Feng Xi was standing in the front row looking at his mobile phone.

When she heard the movement, she turned her head, glanced at Chen Feng, and then looked back with a calm expression.

It doesn't matter anymore.

Although she paid Chen Feng to come back to class last time, Chen Feng did not agree.

But Feng Xi did not give up.

During the half month that Chen Feng was absent from class, she went to Liang Yue three times and asked Liang Yue to order Chen Feng to come back to class on the grounds of class attendance and teaching order.

Lao Liang didn't let go, but his attitude had obviously wavered.

Last Friday afternoon, Lao Liang even took the initiative to tell her, "Chen Feng, I'll talk to him sometime."

As soon as these words came out, Feng Xi knew that the matter was settled.

As long as Lao Liang speaks and withdraws his previous promise, Chen Feng will have to come back to class honestly.

The attendance rate has returned to normal, and there will no longer be any problems with her selection as an outstanding class leader.

As for what Chen Feng is here for today, does he want to participate in the provincial competition selection...

Feng Xi swiped the screen of his phone and didn't take it seriously.

This is impossible.

She retracted her thoughts and continued to look at her phone.

other side.

Wu Zhichao and Lin Yuan came over.

"Brother Feng?"

Wu Zhichao looked surprised, "Why are you willing to come today? I thought you were going to miss it until the end."

Chen Feng raised his eyebrows slightly: "Can't you come to class?"

"Okay, of course." Wu Zhichao chuckled twice, "Well, today is the provincial competition quota selection. Are you here to participate in the provincial competition?"

Lin Yuan glanced at Wu Zhichao and then said: "The physical fitness requirement for provincial competition selection is 13 points, and Chen Feng is only over 12 points. Don't talk nonsense."

However, Chen Feng did not explain, but nodded calmly.

"I'm just here to participate in the selection."

"Huh?"

Wu Zhichao and Lin Yuan were slightly stunned, and then looked at each other in astonishment, almost wondering if they had heard wrongly.

The two wanted to ask again.

At this time, the class bell rang.

"Ding——"

The door of the training room was pushed open from the outside, and Liang Yue walked in with a folder under his arm.

He was wearing a gray sportswear, his hair was shaved short, and he was in good spirits.

After entering the door, he scanned the heads first. When his eyes glanced at Chen Feng's position, his steps slowed down slightly.
